# Rehoboth Cafe

> Ethiopian and Eritrean restaurant and cafe at 2737 Danforth Ave, Toronto, ON M4C 1L8, Canada, on the Danforth in East Toronto near Main Street subway station. Serves breakfast, brunch, lunch, dinner and freshly brewed coffee, with vegan dishes and 100% teff (gluten-free) injera. Open 7 days.

## Key facts

- Name: Rehoboth Cafe (also searched as Rehoboth Ethiopian Restaurant)
- Cuisine: Ethiopian, Eritrean, breakfast, brunch, coffee
- Address: 2737 Danforth Ave, Toronto, ON M4C 1L8, Canada
- Neighbourhood: the Danforth, East Toronto, a short walk east of Main Street Station (TTC Line 2)
- Phone: (416) 686-1104
- Hours: Monday to Saturday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.
- Price range: about CAD $10 to $20 per person
- Service: dine-in, takeout, pickup by phone, delivery and pickup on Uber Eats
- Dietary: Shiro and Misir Wot are vegan; injera is made from 100% teff and is naturally gluten-free; Chechebsa can be made with teff. Some dishes use wheat.
- Website: https://rehobothcafe.com/
- Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?cid=4611536118844118917
- Uber Eats: https://www.ubereats.com/ca/store/rehoboth-cafe/jhYey4mHVrmGnr6VLw1X4Q
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/rehobothcafetoronto/

## Menu (prices in CAD; may change)

### Breakfast

- Tibs Firfir, CAD $17.99: A delightful combination of tender tibs meat and firfir, creating a savoury and satisfying meal.
- Ful, CAD $14.99: A savoury and filling dish made from fava beans, seasoned with spices, and often garnished with fresh vegetables and egg (boiled or scrambled) and some kibe, olive oil or sesame oil.
- Chechebsa (gluten-free option), CAD $15.99: Small, bite-sized pieces of flatbread sautéed with spices and butter or oil. Made with whole wheat or white wheat, prepared with olive oil or kibe (clarified butter). Also available made with gluten-free teff.
- Firfir, CAD $15.99: A spicy and tangy dish made from shredded injera (Ethiopian and Eritrean flatbread) mixed with a rich berbere sauce.
- Genfo, CAD $17.99: A hearty and nutritious porridge for a comforting start to your day. Made with whole wheat or white wheat, prepared with olive oil or kibe (clarified butter).
- Bula, CAD $16.99: A traditional Ethiopian breakfast made from the starch of the enset plant, with a unique and wholesome flavour.
- Waffle, CAD $9.99: Crisp, golden waffles with your choice of toppings: mango, banana or blueberry.

### Lunch & Dinner

- Shiro (vegan), CAD $16.99: A rich and creamy chickpea stew, slow-cooked with a blend of spices. Often enjoyed with injera.
- Tibs, CAD $23.49: A traditional Ethiopian and Eritrean stir-fry of tender beef, lamb or goat, sautéed with onions, peppers and an aromatic blend of spices. Served with injera.
- Misir Wot / Adess (vegan), CAD $16.99: A hearty lentil stew slow-cooked with a blend of spices and herbs. Served with injera.
- Kitfo, CAD $24.99: Finely minced raw beef seasoned with mitmita (a spicy chili powder) and niter kibbeh (clarified butter). Served with injera or kocho.
- Special Kitfo, CAD $27.99: Kitfo mixed with ayib (cottage cheese) and gomen (kale).
- Bula Kitfo, CAD $27.99: An enhanced version of the classic kitfo, served with bula for an extra layer of flavour and texture.
- Tira Sega, CAD $22.00: Raw beef pieces served with injera, mitmita and awaze.
- Rehoboth Special (Meal for 3), CAD $59.99: A meal for three, including tibs, firfir and kitfo. A delightful and diverse tasting experience for sharing.

### Drinks

- Cappuccino, CAD $3.99: Rich espresso with steamed milk and a creamy cap of foam.
- Macchiato, CAD $3.49: Espresso topped with a small dollop of steamed milk foam.
- Tea, CAD $2.49: Classic hot tea, gently steeped for an aromatic cup.
- Organic Ginger Tea, CAD $5.99: A soothing, aromatic tea made from organic ginger, perfect for relaxation.
- Ginger Ale, CAD $1.99: Crisp, carbonated soft drink with a smooth ginger flavour.
- Coke, CAD $1.99
- Perrier, CAD $2.99
- Crush, CAD $1.99
- Water, CAD $1.99

## Frequently asked questions

- **Where is Rehoboth Cafe?** We’re at 2737 Danforth Avenue, Toronto, ON M4C 1L8.
- **What are your opening hours?** Monday to Saturday 9 a.m. to 8 p.m., and Sunday 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.
- **Do you deliver?** Yes. Order Ethiopian and Eritrean food delivery or pickup from Rehoboth Cafe on Uber Eats. Delivery is available to addresses within Uber Eats’ range of 2737 Danforth Ave.
- **Do you have gluten-free options?** Yes. Our injera is made from 100% teff, which is naturally gluten-free, and our Chechebsa can be made with teff too. Some dishes use wheat, so please tell our team about any allergies when you order.
- **Can I order for pickup?** Yes. Call us at (416) 686-1104 to order ahead, or order delivery or pickup on Uber Eats.
- **Do you have vegan or vegetarian options?** Yes. Shiro (chickpea stew) and Misir Wot (spiced red lentils) are vegan and served with injera made from 100% teff.
- **Is Rehoboth Cafe near the subway?** Yes. We’re on Danforth Avenue a short walk east of Main Street Station on Line 2 (Bloor–Danforth).
- **Are you open on Sundays?** Yes, we’re open 7 days a week. Sunday hours are 10 a.m. to 7 p.m.
- **Can I get food or coffee to go?** Yes. You can dine in or take out anything on the menu, including coffee. Call (416) 686-1104 to order ahead.
- **Do you serve breakfast and brunch?** Yes. We serve breakfast and brunch on the Danforth, with Ethiopian and Eritrean dishes such as Firfir, Chechebsa, Ful and Genfo, plus waffles and freshly brewed coffee.
